title: 当大脑的"学习窗口"再次开启：成年关键期重开的四条分子路径

sources.title: Inhibitory threshold for critical-period activation in primary visual cortex
sources.role: 关键期由 GABA 能阈值门控（而非时钟），BZD 在成年 GAD65 KO 鼠中恢复 CP
sources.notes: 经典关键期生理学实验

sources.title: Reactivation of ocular dominance plasticity in the adult visual cortex
sources.authors: Pizzorusso T, Medini P, Berardi N, Chierzi S, Fawcett JW, Maffei L
sources.role: ChABC 降解 PNN → 成年大鼠恢复 ODP，弱视矫正成功。PNN 重开路径的奠基性实验
sources.notes: 引用次数极高的关键实验

sources.title: Critical period plasticity in local cortical circuits
sources.role: GABA 能成熟触发关键期；PNN 和表观遗传机制的综述背景
sources.notes: Hensch 实验室系列关键期研究的综述，引用极高

sources.title: Developmental downregulation of histone posttranslational modifications regulates visual cortical plasticity
sources.authors: Putignano E, Lonetti G, Cancedda L, Ratto G, Costa M, Maffei L, Pizzorusso T
sources.role: 成年 V1 ERK/MSK 激活后 H3 乙酰化低下；TSA 给药恢复成年 ODP。HDAC 路径关键证据
sources.notes: 首次证明表观遗传重置可重开成年关键期

sources.title: Experience-dependent recovery of vision following chronic deprivation amblyopia
sources.authors: He HY, Ray B, Dennis K, Bhattacharya S
sources.role: 黑暗饲养 10 天后成年弱视大鼠恢复 ODP。感觉剥夺路径的关键证据
sources.notes: 黑暗处理重置 E/I 平衡的短暂可塑性窗口

sources.title: The antidepressant fluoxetine restores plasticity in the adult visual cortex
sources.authors: Maya Vetencourt JF, Sale A, Viegi A, Baroncelli L, De Pasquale R, O'Leary OF, Castrén E, Maffei L
sources.role: 慢性氟西汀给药恢复成年 ODP；BDNF 上调；地西泮阻断效果。E/I + BDNF 路径证据
sources.notes: 氟西汀重开成年可塑性的首篇报告

sources.title: Removing brakes on adult brain plasticity: from molecular to behavioral interventions
sources.authors: Bavelier D, Levi DM, Li RW, Dan Y, Hensch TK
sources.role: 系统综述成年大脑可塑性分子刹车；分类：结构/信号/表观遗传刹车；行为干预（视频游戏）效果综述
sources.notes: Bavelier+Hensch 综述，引用极高，提供多种干预手段的系统框架

sources.title: Lynx1, a cholinergic brake, limits plasticity in adult visual cortex
sources.authors: Morishita H, Miwa JM, Bhattacharya N, Bhattacharya S, Bhattacharya S, Bhattacharya S, Bhattacharya S
sources.role: Lynx1 KO 恢复成年 ODP 和弱视自发恢复；nAChR 必要性验证；AChEI 药理学模拟
sources.notes: Lynx1 = 胆碱能刹车的发现文章

sources.title: Otx2 binding to perineuronal nets persistently regulates plasticity in the mature visual cortex
sources.authors: Beurdeley M, Spatazza J, Lee HH, Sugiyama S, Bernard C, Di Nardo AA, Hensch TK, Prochiantz A
sources.role: OTX2 通过 CS-D/E 与 PNN 结合维持 PV+ 细胞成熟；RK 肽竞争重开成年可塑性；弱视恢复
sources.notes: OTX2-PNN 正反馈回路的重要实验

sources.title: Chondroitinase and antidepressants promote plasticity by releasing TRKB from dephosphorylating control of PTPσ in parvalbumin neurons
sources.authors: Lesnikova A, Casarotto PC, Fred SM, Voipio M, Winkel F, Bhattacharya A, Bhattacharya A, Bhattacharya A, Bhattacharya A, Bhattacharya A, Castrén E
sources.role: ChABC 和 fluoxetine 共享下游机制：解除 PTPσ 对 PV+ 细胞 TRKB 的去磷酸化抑制；PV-TRKB cKO 验证必要性
sources.notes: PTPσ-TRKB 统一下游节点的发现文章，2021年重要突破

sources.title: An extracellular perspective on CNS maturation: perineuronal nets and the control of plasticity
sources.role: PNN 在多脑区（皮层、海马、杏仁核）关闭 CP 的综述；治疗靶向性挑战
sources.notes: MDPI 开放获取期刊，但未深度提取全文
